facts.fact_text: On 15 September 2006, the applicant, acting on behalf of the unregistered organisation the Macedonian Initiative Committee, notified Blagoevgrad's mayor that the Macedonian Initiative Committee intended to stage a rally at 4 p.m. on 30 September 2006 in Macedonia Square.
The rally planned for 30 September 2006 in Macedonia Square would consist of the laying of wreaths and flowers and the reading of a short address.

On 28 August 2007, the United Macedonian Organisation Ilinden notified the Mayor of Blagoevgrad of its intention to stage a rally on Macedonia Square, in front of Gotse Delchev's monument, at 4.30 p.m. on 12 September 2007.

The rally planned by the United Macedonian Organisation Ilinden for 12 September 2007 would consist of the laying of a wreath and flowers on Gotse Delchev's monument and a short speech, and would last one hour.
On 15 September 2006, Blagoevgrad's mayor replied to the applicant that the rally planned for 30 September 2006 in Macedonia Square could not proceed.

In a final decision of 19 September 2006, the Blagoevgrad District Court found that Blagoevgrad's mayor's decision refusing the rally planned for 30 September 2006 was lawful, because there was a risk that the rights and freedoms of others might be infringed.
Blagoevgrad's mayor banned the United Macedonian Organisation Ilinden's rally planned for 11 or 12 September 2006.
